entities.text: High Court Of Delhi At New Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The learned counsel for petitioner informs per decision of the Coordinate Bench in Arun Kumar vs State of NCT of Delhi & Another Crl.M.C.No.1757/2021 decided on 06.03.2023 the subject FIR being No.147/2020 under Section 406/420/120B IPC registered at police station EOW has been quashed.

entities.text: Arun Kumar vs State of NCT of Delhi & Another Crl.M.C.No.1757/2021
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 2. The learned counsel for petitioner submits with the quashing of the FIR itself, the LOC as was opened against petitioner in this very FIR, be also quashed.
Thus, all consequential action taken pursuant to said FIR shall also go, including the LOC.
3. In these circumstances, the petition becomes infructuous and accordingly stands disposed of.
Pending application, if any, also stands disposed of.

YOGESH KHANNA, J.
